{{Youmay|the level on the [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']]|the [[Level 12|level]] on the ''[[Colossus]]''}}
'''Level 12''' was located on the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']]. It was entirely devoted to the buying and selling of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Many [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] tended to avoid the level due their discomfort with the notion of slavery. The majority of the slaves were [[Alien/Legends|aliens]], but it was not uncommon for [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to find themselves for sale after losing their last [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] on the ''Beach''.
